description: Add sales tax to net prices or back out sales tax from totals (single or batch amounts), using a custom rate %, US state base rate (all 50 states + DC) and optional local city/county rate. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/sales-tax-calculator.

amounts.description: Prices or totals, newline-separated (or JSON array)

localPercent.description: Optional local city/county rate % to add

mode.description: add (price -> total) or reverse (total -> net + tax)

ratePercent.description: Custom tax rate % (optional if state is given)

state.description: 2-letter US state code for base rate, e.g. CA, TX, NY (optional)

name: sales_tax_calculator
title: Sales Tax Calculator API - add or reverse sales tax for one or many amounts
